name: What materials are used for window air leak repair?

mainEntity.name: What materials are used for window air leak repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: We use high-quality, durable materials specifically designed for long-lasting window air leak repair. These include exterior-grade silicone or acrylic latex caulk for sealing gaps, various types of weatherstripping (such as foam, V-strip, or compression types) for movable window parts, and sometimes expanding foam or backer rod for larger gaps. The choice of material depends on the specific location and size of the leak, ensuring optimal performance and aesthetic integration with your home.
